purpose: Repeatable domain profile for regular-school Alberta FSL learners; not a school grade, immersion equivalence, diagnosis, or standardized test.

administration.first_form: For the named learner ids, assign jenn=A and jess=B. For any other learner id, compute unsigned 32-bit FNV-1a over UTF-8 bytes of learner_id + "|" + release_id; assign A when the low bit is 0 and B when it is 1.
administration.reassessment: Use the other form. Do not reuse the same form within 60 days unless the prior attempt contained fewer than three valid scored items in every domain.
administration.exposure: Store every item id shown, even if unanswered or invalid. Never treat a recently taught or previously exposed item as secure progress evidence.
administration.target_timing: Plan two or three sittings. Suggested: listening+reading; vocabulary+writing; speaking. Each sitting should fit the family’s 20-minute limit.
administration.language: Instructions may be English. French stimulus remains French. No translations, hints, correctness feedback, lives, stars, bonuses, or leaderboard effects.

listening.weak: 0-1 correct: administer all 4 foundation items, then stop.
listening.borderline: 2 correct: administer all 4 foundation and all 4 stretch items.
listening.strong: 3-4 correct: administer all 4 stretch items, then stop.

reading.weak: 0-1 correct: administer all 4 foundation items, then stop.
reading.borderline: 2 correct: administer all 4 foundation and all 4 stretch items.
reading.strong: 3-4 correct: administer all 4 stretch items, then stop.

vocabulary_grammar.weak: 0-1 correct: administer all 4 foundation items, then stop.
vocabulary_grammar.borderline: 2 correct: administer all 4 foundation and all 3 stretch items.
vocabulary_grammar.strong: 3 correct: administer all 3 stretch items, then stop.

objective_routing.invariant: Within a tier, preserve the item order in assessment_items.json. Apply routing only after the full entry block is submitted. Invalid items do not count correct or incorrect.

open_sections.writing: Administer all 6 prompts in listed order.
open_sections.speaking: Administer all 5 prompts in listed order. A parent may split the section after any prompt.

replay.play_count_definition: Count every completed or initiated playback after at least 500 ms.
replay.technical_replay: A playback that produces no audible output may be marked technical_invalid and repeated without consuming an allowed play.

invalidity.rule: Exclude from numerator and denominator. Preserve the record. Do not convert to incorrect.
invalidity.replacement: Use the unused item at the same domain, form, and tier only if one exists and has not been exposed. Otherwise report insufficient_evidence; never borrow the parallel-form item during the same run.
invalidity.support: Any hint, translation, coaching, answer reveal, or parent correction before submit sets support_flag=true and excludes the response from independent band calculation. Preserve it as supported evidence.

scoring.objective: One point per correct objective item; zero per incorrect item. Typed responses receive meaning and spelling flags. The item point requires spelling=true when W_ENCODING is tested; otherwise meaning=true earns the item point and spelling is reported separately.
scoring.tier_profile: For each administered tier with at least 3 independent valid items, secure means >=75%; emerging means >=50% and <75%. The domain band is the highest administered tier observed at emerging or secure, labelled with that tier's status. If foundation is below 50%, report below_assessment_floor. Do not infer an unadministered tier.
scoring.ceiling: If stretch is secure, add upper_limit_not_measured=true. If every administered stretch item is correct, also add ceiling_reached=true. Do not claim a level above the bank.
scoring.writing: Use WRITING-ANALYTIC-V1 only after a qualified human reviews the original response. Report each dimension and the prompt-level total. Aggregate only when at least 5 prompts are valid and reviewed.
scoring.speaking: Use SPEAKING-ANALYTIC-V1 only after a qualified human listens to the original audio. A transcript cannot score comprehensibility, fluency, or pronunciation. Aggregate only when at least 4 prompts are valid and reviewed.
scoring.pronunciation: Report rubric observation, device transcript agreement, locale requested/resolved, noise flag, and technical confidence separately. Do not convert transcript agreement to a pronunciation score.
scoring.overall: No total score and no average across domains. Missing domains remain missing.

confidence.high: minimum evidence met, no support, <=1 invalid item, and no contradictory adjacent-tier pattern
confidence.moderate: minimum evidence met but one technical/support concern or adjacent-tier inconsistency exists
confidence.low: minimum evidence barely met, multiple invalid/support events, or strong tier inconsistency

pause_resume.checkpoint: after every submitted response and at every section boundary
pause_resume.resume: Restore exact form, section, item order, exposure list, responses, play counts, and technical flags. Never replay a submitted item as a new scored item.
pause_resume.parent_invalidation: May mark an attempt invalid without deleting it; create a linked replacement run id.
